_readme: Datadog metric monitors for CustomerOps (COPS-07). Each entry in `monitors` is a body for POST /api/v1/monitor on us5. They read the gauges that reportPlatformOpsMetrics submits every 10 minutes from the cops-onboarding-evaluator worker: skout.cops.metric_status (0 ok, 1 warning, 2 critical, tagged metric:<key>), skout.cops.<key> (the value) and skout.cops.report (heartbeat). The account indexes no logs, so these are metric monitors, not log monitors. Thresholds per metric live in code (cops-ops-metrics.service.ts) and are listed in docs/ops/cops-alerts.md. Alerts go to the web app through the Datadog webhook named skout-cops-alerts (setup in docs/ops/cops-alerts.md). Before creating the monitors, also append the team email handle to each message as a fallback for when the web app is down; that address has not been given yet.

monitors.name: [CustomerOps] {{metric.name}} is critical ({{env.name}})
monitors.message: CustomerOps health metric {{metric.name}} is critical in {{env.name}}. Thresholds and runbooks: docs/ops/cops-alerts.md in Skout-AI-Backend. Live values: CustomerOps admin > Operations. @webhook-skout-cops-alerts

monitors.name: [CustomerOps] {{metric.name}} has stayed in warning ({{env.name}})
monitors.message: CustomerOps health metric {{metric.name}} has been at warning or worse for 30 minutes in {{env.name}}. See docs/ops/cops-alerts.md. @webhook-skout-cops-alerts

monitors.name: [CustomerOps] The health report has stopped ({{env.name}})
monitors.message: No CustomerOps health report for 30 minutes in {{env.name}}. The onboarding evaluator worker, Redis or the database is down, or the Datadog API key was rejected, so the other CustomerOps monitors are blind. @webhook-skout-cops-alerts
